title: RNA-seq of isolated primary human CD8+ T cells treated with KDACi with polyclonal stimulation for 6 days
description: Lysine deacetylase inhibitors (KDACi) show immunomodulatory properties, promoting differentiation of an IL7RhiPD1lo memory precursor (MPEC) phenotype on polyclonal stimulation in vitro and enhancing functional memory responses during infection or immunisation in vivo. We isolated (MACS positive selection) primary human CD8+ T cells from healthy blood donors and treated them for 6 days with low dose sodium valproate (5mM, d0) with concurrent stimulation with anti-CD2/3/28 microbeads, then undertook bulk RNAseq of lysed cells.

samples.title: Control_S1
samples.description: Protocols: CD8+ T cells were isolated by positive magnetic selection from leucocyte cones from healthy blood donors before being stimulated with anti-CD2/3/28 microbeads in complete RPMI medium with non-limiting IL2 (10ng/ml) in the presence of either sodium valproate (500uM), vehicle (1 in 10,000 DMSO) or sodium valproate (175uM) with concurrent glutaminolysis inhibition (R162, 25uM) Total RNA was extracted from harvested cell populations using an RNeasy mini kit (Qiagen) with quality assessed using an Agilent BioAnalyser 2100 and RNA quantification performed using a NanoDrop ND-1000 spectrophotometer. Library preparation was undertaken using the SMARTer Stranded Total RNA-seq v2 Pico Input Mammalian kit according to the manufacturer's instructions
